title: The Ripple Effect of Platform Quality Controls in a Submarket: Evidence from a Secondhand Marketplace
eligible_reason: No TWFE difference-in-differences specification in the replication code. Replication.do estimates (i) a first-stage probit for listing in the quality-controlled YanXuan submarket (treat) on seller and listing covariates including the staggered rollout instrument samecity, and (ii) Heckman-corrected probits of the listing-level selling outcome sold30 on the inverse Mills ratio imr and continuous spillover measures (yxpercentbyw and its square, numimagesother, serviceother, competition counts) with year, month and city dummies, restricted to never-adopters. Treatments are continuous (platform adoption rate, peer attributes), the models are nonlinear (probit), and the unit is a one-shot listing without unit fixed effects. The 'staggered' full-text flag refers to the staggered opening of quality-check centers used as an instrument, not to a binary staggered DiD.
design_notes: Listing-level cross-section (infoid) with seller id, listing date, year/mon/city dummies, after (post YanXuan introduction), treat (YanXuan listing), treated (prior adopter), neveradopter, samecity (quality-check center in seller city at listing time), qcduration. Regressions: probit treat ... if after==1, vce(cluster sellerid); probit sold30 imr yxpercentbyw yxpercentbyw2 ... i.year i.mon if neveradopter==1; probit sold30 imr numimagesother [^2] numcompyx yxnumothers numcompfree freenumothers ...; probit sold30 imr serviceother [^2] ... Only six regression commands in the package.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not applicable: no binary staggered treatment regression. samecity switches on at city-specific quality-check-center opening dates but is used only as a probit covariate/instrument.
data_files_note: readme.rtf: 'Due to NDA, we provide a synthetic dataset for replication of main effects.'
priority_note: Not eligible (no DiD; probit selection models with continuous spillover regressors) and synthetic data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). readme.rtf converted with textutil; all six regression commands in Replication.do inspected. Add to data/synthetic_packages.txt if not already listed.
